source: docs/MASTER-PROMPT.md section 11 (Performance budgets). Opus may revise numbers after spike S2, with an ADR.

R1.description: Low-end: x64, 4 cores, 8 GB RAM, integrated graphics, SSD. Budgets are measured here unless stated.

R2.description: ARM64: Snapdragon X-class Copilot+ PC, 16 GB RAM.

R3.description: High-end: x64, 8+ cores, 32 GB RAM, discrete GPU, 4K display.

metrics.name: Cold start to interactive empty window
metrics.notes: Process creation to the window shown, laid out and the UI thread idle (markers ProcessMain, WindowInteractive). Needs the packaged app: tools/MikePDF.Perf/measure-app.ps1, run by the reviewer. Not measured by the headless suite.

metrics.name: Cold open of a 1-page PDF from Explorer to first rendered pixel
metrics.notes: The headless metric is the engine's share only (two engine starts, open, first tile). Process start, XAML and drawing come from the app markers. 'Cold' here means a fresh process with a warm OS file cache; a true cold file cache (after a reboot) is not produced by either tool.

metrics.name: Warm open (app running) to first rendered pixel, typical 20-page PDF
metrics.notes: The headless metric follows the app's own open sequence (a new document engine and pool engine per document) up to the first sharp tile; the UI thread's upload and draw are on top of it. open.engine_warm.first_tile.text20 is the same open in an engine that is already running.

metrics.name: 2,000-page PDF: first page visible
metrics.notes: Same sequence as the warm open, on the generated 2,000-page document. A scanned or image-heavy 2,000-page file will differ: the generated pages are text.

metrics.name: Scroll frame rate on a typical text PDF
metrics.notes: 60 fps sustained on R1; on R3 the display's refresh rate, which is not a fixed number, so no numeric target is set. Needs a continuous 10 s fling as input (measure-app.ps1 -Fling drives the mouse wheel, or a person flings by hand); frames are draws of the page surface, not DWM presents.

metrics.name: No frame over 50 ms during a 10 s fling
metrics.notes: The longest gap between two draws while input was arriving. See scroll.fps for the capture.

metrics.name: Blank area visible while scrolling
metrics.notes: None allowed; a low-res placeholder is always present. Not measured by this harness. Spike S2 counted blank frames from the draw list on a development machine only (docs/spikes/S2.md); a counter in the presenter would make it an automated metric.

metrics.name: Zoom gesture response: sharp tiles after the gesture settles
metrics.notes: Next frame by GPU scaling, sharp tiles within 300 ms of the settle. Not measured by this harness; spike S2 measured it on a development machine.

metrics.name: Search, 500-page text PDF: first result
metrics.notes: FindSession from page 1; the generated document has its first match on page 5, so five pages are searched before the first result.

metrics.name: Search, 500-page text PDF: full results
metrics.notes: Every page searched, 11 matches found. Highlighting the matches on screen is not included.

metrics.name: Ink pen-to-pixel latency
metrics.notes: Surface Pro-class hardware with a pen and a high-speed camera (spike S5, R-17). There is no ink in the app yet (M4). Cannot be measured by software alone.

metrics.name: UI process memory, idle with one 20-page document
metrics.notes: Working set of MikePDF.exe sampled by measure-app.ps1 after the document has drawn and the UI has been idle. Needs the packaged app.

metrics.name: Engine process memory, 500-page document after full scroll
metrics.notes: Peak working set of the document engine after rendering every 512 px tile of every page at 100% (3,000 tiles), three in flight. 1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes. Private bytes are reported next to it.

metrics.name: Install size (MSIX, single architecture)
metrics.notes: Unpacked size of the .msix (the sum of its files), excluding optional AI models; skipped when no package has been built. The size of the .msix file itself is reported as package.msix_file_size. Gated per architecture by the package job of .github/workflows/store-release.yml (build/store/check-package-size.ps1 reads this target); see docs/perf/install-size.md.

metrics.name: Engine crash to restored document
metrics.notes: From killing the sandboxed engine process to the same document rendering a tile in the replacement engine. The in-app banner is not included.
